content.value: An ideal Diesel engine operates on 0.6 kg of air with a suction state of 0.1 MPa and 35°C, 15 the pressure at the end of compression is 36 bar and the cut off is at 6% of the stroke from the head end dead centre position. Using air properties, determine- (i) the compression ratio, (ii) the percentage clearance, (iii) the heat supplied, (iv) the thermal efficiency and (v) mep.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 2nd Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2022
